Man is charged with murder for shooting death of girlfriend near Fair Grove

SPRINGFIELD, Mo. - Prosecutors charged Carlton Wallace, 37, with second-degree murder and armed criminal action on Tuesday afternoon. He is accused of shooting his girlfriend, Lindsay Arnold, 26, in the head on Monday.

The shooting happened at their home southwest of Fair Grove, which is next to the home of Wallace's mother, Esther Wallace. Court records show Wallace with an address in east Springfield but neighbors and his mother say he's been living at the rural property since last summer after a shed was converted into a small home. Arnold lived there with him.

Wallace has a 6-year-old daughter who also lives at the home. The girl was at Fair Grove Elementary School when the shooting was discovered on Monday.

The shooting was at a home in the 4600 block of East Farm Road 48 between Shelby Road on the west and U.S. 65 on the east. Esther Wallace notified the sheriff's department about the shooting just before 1 p.m. Monday.

Officers learned from his mother that Carlton Wallace drove away from the home toward U.S. 65. in Esther Wallace's black 2002 Hyundi Elantra. They put out a bulletin to other law enforcement agencies to be on the lookout for that vehicle.

Springfield police and Missouri State Highway Patrol troopers arrested Wallace in that vehicle in east Springfield about 2:45 on Monday. The car was parked in front of the Walmart Neighborhood Market on South Glenstone Avenue just north of Bennett Street. The arrest was without incident. A tow truck took the car away so it could be processed for potential evidence.

The school district says it is working with the state Children's Division to determine the best living arrangement for the 6-year-old girl.
